confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for a July 2026 peak-season window, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and month. Accommodation anchors include estimated US sales and tourist taxes. The FX observation came from search-result summaries citing the RBA statistics and overview pages. I did not open the RBA page directly, so the 2026-10-16 value should be verified before use. Lodging anchors are the least certain, especially the 1-star and hostel private-room figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other US leisure-driven metros with theme-park or resort tourism, such as Tampa and the Anaheim area, for restaurant and lodging price levels. Summer lodging is priced at a seasonal peak. Cocktail and wine anchors are set at roughly 1.5 to 2 times the beer anchor, consistent with US restaurant bar pricing, because direct knowledge of those prices is weak.
